description.zh: 要停止执行脚本的云电脑ID列表。N的取值范围：1\~50。
description.en: The ID of cloud desktop N. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

description.zh: 脚本进程执行ID。取自[RunCommand](~~RunCommand~~)的返回参数。
地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。

descriptions.zh: 停止单次脚本进程后，已经开始执行脚本的云电脑会继续执行，未开始执行脚本的云电脑将不再执行。
descriptions.en: When you stop a one-time execution of a command, the command continues to run on the cloud desktops where it has started to run, and will not run on the cloud desktops where it has not started to run.
